assertions.statement: All schedule-center routes and overlays use the approved responsive design system without page-level horizontal overflow at 360, 390, 768, and 1440 CSS pixel widths.
The frontend is decomposed into application, feature, shared UI, hook, adapter, and typed service boundaries, and no production TypeScript, TSX, or CSS file exceeds 600 physical lines.

All maintained clients use the current persisted XianGuanJia configuration contract; permissions, tenant behavior, authentication storage, and rental workflows remain server-authoritative, with no legacy configuration fallback.
Every route and required state supports persisted light/dark themes and zh-CN/en locales with accessible keyboard, focus, touch-target, contrast, and reduced-motion behavior.
Shipping preserves the waybill-device-pending-order-confirm-ship sequence, treats OCR as a review draft, and never accepts a business mutation before the backend response.
